scope: First batch: source/implementation applicability review of eight real creation builds, five areas each. Does not execute referenced gameplay tests or claim full-source parity.

recordSemantics.implemented: Reachable implementation exists; gapIds still block acceptance completion.
recordSemantics.no-special-difference: Source and indirect consumers reviewed; shared path applies without an additional class generation branch.
recordSemantics.deferred: Content/identity/player entry unavailable; prerequisite remains explicit.
recordSemantics.evidence: Review and test references are evidence locations, not test execution results. Class/realms/body are resolved from formal content; this file is not a runtime allowlist.

sharedReviews.entry: Natural floor/monster allocation and existing Acquirement service; ordinary modes retain non-tailored kinds.
sharedReviews.reason: All eight default builds resolve to the human standard body; race selection supplies real body slots and Tomte birth-headgear rules. Source object_is_favorite defaults to all melee weapons for Warrior, Berserker, Sniper, High Mage, Paladin and Mindcrafter; Archer and Cavalry have explicit filters. Source device-class membership is independent of ability to use devices. Completed-item rejection follows caster glove encumbrance, not general usability.

src/berserker.c:161-172 HP caster without glove flag

sharedReviews.entry: Shared natural/Ego materialization, existing configured rewards and Craft consumers; no new Craft realm.
sharedReviews.reason: No eight-class-specific Ego materializer appears in reviewed source: weight adjustment belongs to unavailable Mauler. Existing luck mutations, Chance virtue, themes, race/body properties and curse consumers still apply and can differ by real character state; no-special-difference means no additional class branch, not identical output.
sharedReviews.limits: Shared tests and E8.8 are prior evidence; new-build generator-to-consumer evidence is tracked separately.

sharedReviews.entry: Natural/themed scheduler passes real class and theme with scroll=false; CREATE_ART_SCROLL player entry is unavailable.
sharedReviews.reason: Theme supplies initial bias. Without a theme there is no class initial bias in natural mode. Only scroll mode with no prior bias and the 1/4 gate applies class bias; later Warrior conversion depends on mode. Non-Bard harp value and shared value/curse retries apply. Berserker alone changes resistance case 31 among current classes.
sharedReviews.limits: The class-bias test injects class IDs with scroll=true and checks eligible biases, not exact probabilities or a playable scroll entry. No new source parity or desktop result is claimed.

sharedReviews.entry: Imported fixed artifacts and explicitly configured class reward pools.
sharedReviews.reason: Of ten source identity-sensitive artifacts, only Dr Jones (162) is imported and uses its ordinary non-Archaeologist branch. Terror Mask is absent even though Warrior/Cavalry/Berserker qualify in source. Meditation Stone class bonuses and other imported rewards are actual use/reward behavior; they do not add a class branch to fixed-artifact construction.
sharedReviews.limits: Absent identity-sensitive artifacts and fixed harps remain deferred; explicit rewards must keep their forced-item contract.

sharedReviews.entry: Equip/use/reject generated instances, identify/sense, combat or attributes, native save/load and continued actions.
sharedReviews.reason: Generation eligibility and item usability are separate. Actual equipment properties feed existing class, skill and realm consumers; instances and RNG are persisted by the shared save path. Prior consumer evidence does not automatically establish a new build's generation round trip.
sharedReviews.limits: B0-B6/E8.8 cover the prior six-build generation scope; profession desktop scenarios alone do not close new generated-item differences.
